propositions: Exact single-object JSON replies are decoded twice via _all_json_objects and json.loads, creating duplicate identical candidate dicts.
Identity comparison (is not) between separately constructed Pydantic instances incorrectly classifies semantically equal candidates as ambiguous conflicts.
Native structured LLM replies emit false 'multiple candidates validated' warnings despite first/last values being equal and serialization-equivalent.
Deduplication of value-equal decoded dicts in discovery order before validation eliminates false ambiguity warnings while preserving last-valid-wins for genuinely distinct candidates.
Semantic equality of decoded candidates must determine deduplication, not instance identity, to prevent parser-generated false conflicts.
